observations: A white PlayStation 4 console wrapped in plastic film.
A black PlayStation 4 controller wrapped in plastic film.
A yellow sticker on the console with handwritten text 'PS4 500GB'.
A black power adapter is visible at the bottom of the frame.
The console and controller are resting on a marble-patterned surface.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI SHOW GAMES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console is white, which is the standard color for the PS4 Slim. The 'Japan' model is not visually identifiable from the photos.
The presence of plastic wrapping and the context of a used goods listing suggest the item is not new.
Only the console and controller are visible; the power adapter is partially visible but not clearly shown.
No games are visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a faulty optical drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully launching a game.

risks.risk: The console may be a refurbished or 'grey market' unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.

risks.risk: The console may be missing the original power adapter.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and the console's power port.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.
Video of the console powering on and launching a game.
Photo of the game disc tray and any games included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
